protocol.hypothesis: After two causally confirmed same-side ZigZag pivots define a support or resistance line, the first later third contact may create a tradable bounce or breakout in either price-trend direction.
protocol.parameter_rationale: Three preregistered line sources: chart 1H/4H, completed 1D, completed 1W. For each, bounce and breakout each cover wing 3/5, deviation 2/4%, contact zone 0.5/1%, max age 50/100 source bars: 96 variants plus baseline. Both support and resistance and both trade directions are tested in every variant.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and 1H/4H signal timeframe, filled next open; separately compare chart-source third touch against the existing two-pivot trendline-breakout experiment.
protocol.signal_rule: Two confirmed same-side ZigZag pivots on the selected chart, completed daily or completed weekly source define a projected support/resistance line. The higher-source pivot becomes usable only on the next date after its confirmation candle; no partial day/week is read. On the first later third contact, bounce enters away from the line after a rejecting close, or breakout enters through it after a beyond-zone close. Both support and resistance are eligible regardless of line slope. Ignore ambiguous simultaneous contacts and use each anchor pair once. Signal on completed 1H/4H close; fill next open; opposite signal closes/reverses.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Screen all completed results using the current eval policy; no automatic real-order approval.
limitations: User-drawn line is an example, not a fixed objective indicator
A confirmed pivot is visible only wing bars after its center
No actual third-contact profit is assumed from the screenshot
Corporate actions are not fully covered; research status only
The 1D/1W line is projected in completed higher-bar steps during 1H/4H sessions, not fitted to wall-clock time.

research_provenance.note: Visual example only; no future line or trade outcome is used as data.

protocol.signal_semantics: Single-stock long/short order signal on closed bar; next-open execution. Pivot is usable only on confirmation bar, never at its plotted historical position.
protocol.availability_lag: Chart pivot: wing completed chart bars; daily/weekly pivot: wing completed higher bars plus next trading date after confirming higher candle. No current unfinished day/week is used.

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
